Five controllers are shown: one red/black (DualSense style), one white, one black, and two others in the background.
The black controller in the foreground has heavily worn thumbsticks with the rubber coating completely missing.
The white controller has tape or a sticker across the top of the touchpad.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'FUTURE ECHINA' are present on both images.
The console appears to be a PlayStation 4 Pro based on the three-tier chassis.
